reason: I already hate typing openers by hand, so the pain is real, but every AI DM I've seen sounds robotic and my prospects can smell it. $147 is nothing against what I make, but a card-required trial with zero published results and only 3 days to judge replies isn't enough for me to bet my own Instagram account on it.
objection: AI-written DMs sound robotic and prospects can tell, and nobody has shown me one real result. Three days isn't long enough to see whether anyone actually replies or books, and then it bills with no refunds.
would_change_my_mind: Real sample DMs written for actual profiles that read like a person wrote them, plus a few named agency owners showing reply and booked-call numbers, and a longer trial or a refund window.
